items.title: Carl Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, Atlanta, Georgia, January 4, 2013
items.q: The transcript only shows Monk Rowe introducing himself as the interviewer and Carl Allen as the interviewee. No personal or professional relationship beyond the interview context is described.

ctx.x: Carl was interviewed in Atlanta, GA, on January 4, 2013, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are at the JazzEd Network Conference in Atlanta. And I’m pleased to have Carl Allen with me this afternoon. And if you were at a party and someone who you didn’t know asked you, “Well what do you do for a living —”
